en.headline: Hong Kong names 11-strong equestrian squad for Asian Games
en.dek: The team will compete in dressage, eventing and jumping at the Tokyo venue, mixing experienced riders with three debutants.
body: Hong Kong, China has selected 11 horse-and-rider combinations for the equestrian events at this year’s Asian Games, the Equestrian Federation of Hong Kong, China and the Hong Kong Jockey Club announced on Friday.

The squad will contest dressage, eventing and jumping in both team and individual competitions at the JRA Equestrian Park in Tokyo. Entries from 22 countries and regions are expected, more than at the previous Games in Hangzhou.

Experienced riders Patrick Lam and Annie Ho will each compete in two disciplines. Three athletes will make their Asian Games debuts: Sheikara Lalive d’Epinay in jumping, and Yuddy Cheng and Kendra Li in dressage. All selected athletes are currently based in Europe for final training. Federation president Lester Huang said the team combined an experienced core with fresh talent.

zh.headline: 港隊公布亞運馬術11人名單 涵蓋三項賽事
zh.dek: 香港中國馬術總會公布亞運馬術代表隊，將於東京場地出戰盛裝舞步、三日賽及場地障礙賽。
body: 香港中國馬術總會與香港賽馬會周五公布今屆亞運會馬術代表隊名單，共11組人馬組合出戰。
代表隊將在東京日本中央競馬會馬術公園出賽，涵蓋盛裝舞步、三日賽及場地障礙賽的團體及個人項目。預計有22個國家及地區參賽，多於上屆杭州亞運。
資深騎手林子威及何靄莉各出戰兩項賽事。三名首次出戰亞運的騎手包括場地障礙賽的Sheikara Lalive d’Epinay，以及盛裝舞步的鄭宇迪及李嘉恩。全體選手現於歐洲進行最後訓練。總會會長黃嘉純表示，隊伍結合經驗核心與新血。
